title: Target environment
summary: A case's target_envs names registered environments; [] keeps the plan default. Each target creates its own delivery obligation. The control plane records and executes QA against project-owned environments or an authorized same-org hosted-runtime bridge, rechecking the frozen environment identity on dispatch. The owning environment ID selects its origin and qa.identity_path. Begin, owner resume and each result write observe the full served SHA; heartbeats and host operations recheck only authorization. Results persist served_build_sha and served_build_status. A missing declared path is recorded; an unanswerable probe refuses served_build_unobservable, and a changed build refuses served_build_changed with both SHAs and requires a new execution. An execution whose every case runs on a Test Machine survives a redeploy: owner resume skips the build check and each result records served_build_changed with both SHAs in raw_result. Deployment and project targets retain their own identity rules.
